label: es-e1b
change: OriginalMusic (9 files, pure renames) moves from NTSDMacPlatform, which loses its resources, to NTSDContent; it joins the content bundle in non-portable (Mac) builds only and is excluded from portable ones, as NTSDMacPlatform's bundle held it only there. OriginalMacMusicOutput.directory/bundled take an OriginalContentLocation (NTSDApp passes NTSDContent.location()); NTSDHeadless and NTSDSDL source-tree fallbacks, OriginalALACTrackTests, PortableSHA256Tests (one root, the same files) and 15 active tools follow; the test helper adds the Bundle overloads. Harness: ios_app.py takes NTSD_SIM_SET (a device set elsewhere, created on first use, absolute path, runtime filtered by supported device type); web_app.py refuses a bundle holding OriginalMusic.
checks: debug build of every Mac target and the tests: two compile errors of the first version fixed before any gate (a missing `import NTSDCore` in OriginalMacMusicPlayer.swift; a test call `Output.directory()` the caller search had missed)
the two music test classes in the debug build: 9 tests pass

portable debug build: content bundle holds the seven packages and no OriginalMusic; clean Mac build: one content bundle with the eight, no NTSDMacPlatform bundle; neither build warns about unhandled files

review.by: a separate read-only agent, 2026-10-18, on the staged diff, then on the fix
review.first: music lookup behaviour-neutral for every host; REQUIRED: copying OriginalMusic into NTSDContent on every platform would ship the music twice in the APK (~236 MB more extracted on the A12), the Linux/Windows packages and the web's eager packs (~118 MB more per visit), and break ios_app.py (FileExistsError)
review.fix: option A: the music in the content bundle on non-portable builds only (exclude on portable)
review.second: fix confirmed: every portable packager ships what it shipped at ce337708 apart from E1a's name; Mac builds and tests find the music in the content bundle; exclude valid; ios_app.py edits correct. Caution adopted: wasm builds must set NTSD_PORTABLE=1, now also enforced by web_app.py.
